description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map', a specialized plot area used for map visualizations within the Image_Graph package. It handles loading map images, mapping geographic points to pixel coordinates, scaling, and rendering a map with plotted points. The class interacts with map image files and associated coordinate text files, and extends the base plot area class.

classes.description: A plot area for rendering maps with plotted geographic points, including map image loading, coordinate mapping, scaling, and rendering.
